whenToUse: The front page of a magazine, news site, or blog.
whenNotToUse: All articles are equally important (use a card grid).
accessibility: The DOM order is lead story then supporting stories, matching the visual order.
Titles are links, and each story is wrapped in an article.
Images are decorative, so they're aria-hidden, and the titles carry the content.
On narrow screens it stacks in one column, readable when zoomed.
